$janet.$comment: Not JSON Schema. Read by scripts/Test-OutputContracts.ps1, which is the point of the file living here rather than being generated from the return type.
$janet.$comment.contractField: The envelope stamps 'contract' and the gate cross-checks it against the number above, so code and schema cannot drift apart in either direction.
$janet.$comment.everyKey: Every key is always present; a value that does not apply is null rather than absent, so a reader can tell 'not applicable' from 'this version does not report it'.
$janet.$comment.sampledOnlyWhereSignedIn: A live sample needs 'az login' and a resource group to compare against. AzureSchemaTests holds the serializer to this file without either.

contract.description: Bumped only by a format change. An engine change that moves this number is a mistake in one direction; a format change that does not is a mistake in the other.

path.description: The full path of the .bicep or .bicepparam that was compiled and compared.

subscription.description: Which subscription the comparison ran against, and how that was decided.

resourceGroup.description: The resource group compared against, as the caller named it.

deploymentName.description: The deployment name the what-if was posted under: the caller's, or the file's stem plus a UTC timestamp. A what-if creates no deployment record, so this name is not something to look up afterwards.

outcome.description: What happened. 'compared': ARM answered, and changes/summary are the answer. 'notCompiled': the Bicep did not build, nothing was sent to Azure, and diagnostics say why. 'rejected': ARM refused the what-if or it failed while running, and error says why. Only 'compared' carries changes.

diagnostics.description: What Bicep said while compiling, errors and warnings alike -- present whatever the outcome, because a template that compares can still carry warnings.

summary.description: How many resources fall under each of ARM's change types, counting EVERY resource -- including the noChange and ignore ones that changes leaves out unless includesUnchanged. All zeros unless outcome is 'compared'.

delete.description: Resources that would be deleted. Incremental mode, the only one this tool uses, deletes nothing the template leaves out, so a non-zero count here deserves a close look.

modify.description: Existing resources whose properties would change. Includes resources ARM only THINKS would change because a value is an unevaluated expression -- see unresolved.

deploy.description: Resources that would be redeployed but whose change ARM cannot predict.

noChange.description: Resources that exist and would stay as they are.

ignore.description: Resources in the group the template does not mention, which incremental mode leaves alone.

unsupported.description: Resources the what-if service cannot evaluate; each listed change says why in unsupportedReason.

unresolved.description: How many LISTED changes carry at least one value the what-if could not evaluate (a reference() to a resource it has not deployed, and kin). Those are reported as changes whether or not anything will change, so this is the count to discount before believing modify.

includesUnchanged.description: Whether noChange and ignore resources are listed in changes. False means they are counted in summary and left out of changes.

changes.description: One entry per resource, in ARM's order. Empty unless outcome is 'compared'.

changeType.description: ARM's changeType, camel-cased. The meanings are those under summary.

resource.description: The resource id relative to its resource group (provider/type/name), for reading; the full id when it lies outside a resource group.

resourceId.description: The full ARM resource id, for passing on.

unresolved.description: True when a delta's after-value or a field's value is an ARM expression the what-if could not evaluate. Such a change may be no change at all.

deltas.description: For a modify: each property that would change, flattened to a leaf path. Empty for every other change type.

path.description: Dotted path from the resource root, nested children joined; an array index is written [i], e.g. properties.ipRules[0].

change.description: ARM's propertyChangeType, camel-cased. 'create': the property appears. 'delete': it disappears. 'modify': its value changes. 'array': an array changes in ways its children describe (only seen when it has none). 'noEffect': it differs but ARM will not change it, such as a read-only property.

before.description: The value before: a string as itself, anything else as compact JSON, cut at 200 characters with '...' appended. Null when there was none, as for a 'create'.

after.description: The value after, rendered the same way. Null when there will be none, as for a 'delete'.

unresolved.description: True when after is an unevaluated ARM expression such as "[reference(...)]". A value starting "[[" is ARM's escaped literal bracket and is NOT one.

fields.description: For a create or a delete: the resource's own properties (after for a create, before for a delete), scalars flattened to paths starting 'properties'. This is what tells a role assignment for the right principal from one for the wrong one. Empty for every other change type.

path.description: Dotted path, array indexes written [i], e.g. properties.principalId.

value.description: The scalar, rendered as for a delta and cut at 200 characters; the JSON literal 'null' written as the string null.

unresolved.description: True when the value is an unevaluated ARM expression, as for a delta.

fieldsTruncated.description: True when the resource had more than 25 scalar properties and fields lists only the first 25.

unsupportedReason.description: Why ARM could not evaluate this resource, for an 'unsupported' change. Null otherwise.

error.description: Why ARM refused, for outcome 'rejected', with its nesting kept. Null for 'compared' and for 'notCompiled', whose reasons are in diagnostics.

durationSeconds.description: Wall time from start to answer, compile and polling included, rounded to hundredths.

name.description: The subscription's display name when it was read from the Azure CLI profile. Null when the caller passed an id, which is used as given without a lookup.

source.description: How it was decided. 'explicit': the caller named it, by id or by name. 'az default': the Azure CLI profile's default subscription. 'scope': read out of the ARM id the caller passed as a scope.

code.description: The service's error code, e.g. InvalidTemplateDeployment or AuthorizationFailed; 'HTTP nnn' when the service gave none, '(no code)' when ARM's error object lacked one.

message.description: The service's message, verbatim. Empty when it gave none.

target.description: What the error is about -- a resource, a property -- when the service said. Null when it did not.

details.description: The nested errors, in the same shape, as deep as the service sent them. The outer error is often a wrapper and the reason is here.

level.description: SARIF's level vocabulary, which is what Bicep emits. A result with no level is a 'warning' (SARIF's default, and how Bicep marks linter findings).

code.description: A BCPnnn compiler code, a linter rule name, '(no rule)' when SARIF gave none, or '(bicep)' when Bicep failed without SARIF and the message is what it printed.

file.description: Local path of the file the finding is in, which can be a module or a .bicepparam's template. Null when SARIF gave no location.

line.description: 1-based line; null when SARIF gave no region.

column.description: 1-based column in UTF-16 code units; null when SARIF gave no region.
